acceptance_criteria.observable: On a DONE mission page, the UI shows a Start the next mission form; submitting a valid outcome creates a new DRAFT mission and exposes editable CHARTER.md and SPEC.json for that new mission.

oracle.description: A browser-driven check against a DONE test project submits the start form, then /api/overview reports DRAFT with the submitted goal, editable CHARTER.md and SPEC.json, and no console errors.

constraints: Preserve unrelated user work and existing behavior outside the goal
Preserve terminal DONE semantics: no further action is legal under the completed mission
Do not change runtime protocol gates or receipt semantics
non_goals: UI redesign or new visual language

requirements.statement: UI should allow starting the next mission after a DONE mission

stop_conditions: Stop or pivot when the goal cannot be proven within the iteration budget
Stop if starting a new mission requires mutating or continuing the completed mission
Pivot if the existing /api/missions endpoint cannot safely create the next mission after DONE
